name: A borrowed guise for old records

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: A disguise opens a way to records guarded by suspicion and old allegiances. The faction quest asks its chosen seeker to recover the ancient dragonforged blades’ history, not to invent a new forging tale. In this retelling, the folio is an interpretive emblem for that record. A successful theft is a game objective; the chronicle keeps the danger and purpose, not every repeated step of play.
